core: Axial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Notochord and neural plate morphogenesis during axis elongation
rationale: Members cover notochord/axial and paraxial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate/fold formation; convergent extension, paraxial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis separate it from the spinal-cord patterning and neural-plate-border confusables.

name: Lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern lateral plate mesoderm formation, mesenchyme migration and embryonic gut/hindgut morphogenesis, unlike the gastrulation, primitive-streak and endoderm confusables.

name: Prostate gland and genital tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover prostate budding, branching and epithelial differentiation plus uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia development, distinguishing it from salivary/mammary branching and gonad-determination confusables.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members combine SLBP-dependent/independent histone pre-mRNA processing and Pol II termination with export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore; histone stem-loop processing separates it from export-only and polyadenylation confusables.

core: Vascular smooth muscle and endothelial shear-stress response
name: Aortic smooth muscle and endothelial shear-stress response
rationale: Members cover aortic and vascular smooth muscle development with SRF contractile targets and endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory flow; aorta development and shear-stress signaling separate it from smooth-muscle phenotypic-switching confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar supply and GPI anchor synthesis
rationale: Members cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters and their defects, and GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, rather than the N-glycan, O-glycan and glycolipid elaboration of the confusables.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle with integration and Rev RNA export
rationale: Members trace HIV-1 entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, Rev export and Env synthesis; integration and Rev-mediated export distinguish it from restriction-factor, latency and other-virus confusables.

name: Axon sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members cover axon outgrowth, collateral sprouting, peripheral axon regeneration and Sema3A/RhoA growth inhibition, whereas confusables centre on netrin, Slit-Robo and ephrin axon pathfinding.

qualifier: centrosome maturation by PLK1 and Aurora A
name: Mitotic spindle assembly, centrosome maturation and cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle assembly, checkpoint, centrosome maturation (AURKA/TPX2, PLK1, NuMA) and cleavage furrow/contractile ring; centrosome maturation separates it from chromatid-cohesion, nuclear-envelope and spindle-orientation confusables.

name: Male sex determination and testis differentiation
rationale: Members cover gonadal mesoderm, testis-determining transcription, AMH signaling and Leydig cell differentiation, unlike the germ cell, ovarian and genital-tract confusables.

qualifier: ISG15, OAS and PKR effectors with feedback regulation
name: Type I interferon signaling with ISG15, OAS, PKR effectors
rationale: Members cover interferon-alpha/beta response and its negative regulation together with ISG15, OAS and PKR antiviral effectors, which distinguish it from the antiviral signature and nucleic-acid sensing confusables.

core: Synapse assembly and dendritic spine development
name: Synapse assembly, trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
rationale: Members cover pre/postsynaptic assembly, neurexin-neuroligin and other synaptic adhesion, glutamate/GABA receptor clustering and dendrite/spine morphogenesis, unlike the receptor-activation, LTP-calcium and vesicle-recycling confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing
name: Chemokine-driven dendritic cell and lymphocyte migration
rationale: Members combine chemokine-receptor binding and chemotaxis modules with myeloid dendritic cell chemotaxis/differentiation and lymphocyte homing adhesion, distinguishing it from T cell, NK and monocyte chemotaxis confusables.

qualifier: TRIF-dependent TLR3/TLR4 branch and cell death
name: TRIF-dependent TLR3/TLR4 signaling and programmed cell death
rationale: Members cover TRIF/TICAM1-TRAF6-TAK1 and RIP1-IKK signaling, TRIF-mediated cell death and TLR3/4 regulation, unlike MyD88/IRAK TLR7/8/9 and IRF3 confusables.

qualifier: calcineurin signaling, atrophy and fiber-type switching
name: Calcineurin-dependent striated muscle adaptation, atrophy and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members cover calcineurin-NFAT signaling, stress hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation, disuse atrophy and fast-slow fiber transition, distinguishing it from cell-size and sarcomere growth confusables.

name: Late endosome-Golgi and COPI-independent Golgi-ER retrograde traffic
rationale: Members cover endosome-Golgi exchange, Golgi retention, COPI-independent Golgi-to-ER traffic and vesicular cholesterol transport, unlike the COPI, lysosome-biogenesis and recycling-endosome confusables.

name: Ectodermal organ development: epidermis, hair follicle and tooth
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, hair follicle, gland, nail and tooth/odontoblast development and ectodermal dysplasia, with tooth and EDA-ID members separating it from pigmentation and junction confusables.

name: TLR7/8/9 and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing regulation
rationale: Members cover regulation of endosomal TLR7/8/9 signaling and cGAS-STING with TREX1 and interferon-beta output; cGAS-STING members distinguish it from the endosomal-TLR and RNA editing confusables.

name: Myeloid inflammatory activation with neutrophil degranulation and complement receptors
rationale: Members cover inflammatory TLR signaling, monocyte/neutrophil modules, complement receptor signaling and neutrophil degranulation, unlike the formyl-peptide chemotaxis and SIRP-phagocytosis confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, arsenite and PKR stress responses and TTP/BRF1/KSRP-mediated mRNA destabilization, distinguishing it from heat-shock and mRNA-stabilization confusables.

name: Nucleoside and xenobiotic drug transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover plasma membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analog drugs together with xenobiotic export and drug response, unlike the nucleotide interconversion and catabolism confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion-derived valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardium differentiation, cushion EMT and fusion, and formation of all four valves and the atrial/ventricular septa, unlike the myocardial and heart-tube confusables.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism via transsulfuration and sulfide oxidation
rationale: Members cover homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration, cysteine and serine catabolism and hydrogen sulfide oxidation; sulfide oxidation separates it from selenium, glutathione and choline confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and TGF-beta EMT signaling
rationale: Members cover adherens junction assembly and calcium/cadherin adhesion, and TGF-beta EMT signaling with positive regulation of cadherin adhesion distinguishes it from CDH1-turnover and polarity confusables.

qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption, fructose, galactose and pentose
name: Dietary sugar absorption and fructose, galactose, pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover intestinal digestion and absorption of hexoses, fructose and galactose (Leloir) catabolism, non-oxidative pentose phosphate and glycerol/glucuronate metabolism with their inherited defects, unlike the glycolysis and glycogen confusables.
